title: From Physical Information to Christic Consciousness

required.mustExplain: A non-linear developmental map from quantum states through chemistry, life, subconscious integration, consciousness, and Christic self-transcendence.

promptCompiler.finalPrompt:
Create a high-resolution quantum-process-diagram titled "From Physical Information to Christic Consciousness".
The image must visually explain: A non-linear developmental map from quantum states through chemistry, life, subconscious integration, consciousness, and Christic self-transcendence.
Style: museum-quality scientific book illustration.
Composition: clear central concept, readable hierarchy, uncluttered layout.
Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Use coherent scientific visual language, clean labels only when helpful, and strong print readability.
Avoid: fake citations, fake equations, unreadable text, watermarks, copyrighted characters, random mystical clutter, misleading scientific labels.
